parameters.query: SELECT id, provider, decision FROM mail.ingestion_event WHERE (provider = $1 AND mailbox_address = $2 AND provider_message_id = $3) OR (content_hash = $4) LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO rag.document (
  id, source_type, external_id, title, content_preview,
  project_code, project_name, from_address, received_at,
  metadata, created_at, updated_at
) VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(), 'EMAIL', $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::timestamptz,
  $8::jsonb, now(), now()
)
ON CONFLICT (source_type, external_id) DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  content_preview = EXCLUDED.content_preview,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO mail.ingestion_event (
  event_id, provider, mailbox_address, provider_message_id,
  internet_message_id, from_address, subject, received_at,
  content_hash, decision, reason, classification,
  classification_confidence, project_code, is_business_related,
  requires_manual_review, created_at
) VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(), $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::timestamptz,
  $8, $9, $10, $11, $12::numeric, $13, $14::boolean, $15::boolean, now()
)
ON CONFLICT (provider, mailbox_address, provider_message_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING event_id;
